author: StewieFG
body:
Hey! :D

I'm pround to release my new map for the contest- TropicZ! 

Name: TropicZ

Gamemode: Nexus

Info:
-2 Teams (Yellow & Cyan)
-Alot of space for PvP
-Middle bridges
-Very detailed and gameplay wised map
-15v15
-Cool mountains
-Tropic themed

Images: http://imgur.com/a/gWqUz

Download: Coming soon.

YAML: http://pastebin.com/Lx63BVsC

I hope you like it, and Feedback is always appreciated! <3
-Electra

replies.author: Atheyna
replies.body:
I'm sorry, But the judges for the map building contest have decided to deny your map for the following reasons:

-  We think that TropicZ could use a lot more decoration. This decoration could include houses, shrines of some sort, or even trees. In other words, it is quite plain.
- The bridges that connect the Yellow side to the Cyan side are a huge choke point of the map. Providing more ways to cross into the other teams territory will increase gameplay efficiency by so so much.
- Although, really excellent terraforming it just needs a lot more to the map.  

Aesthetics -  2/5
Gameplay - 2/5 
Creativity -  3/5

Thank you for submitting your map! I hope you participate in our next building competition!
